One small cue, then the drop — no talking

ideas.title: The city that made the set

modeled_on.title: being a dj living in miami has always been the dream for me. this city has been an endless source of inspiration every year with music week and easily has the best club culture in america. here is where u can break new records, experiment with unheard sounds, and discover the best up and coming talent while dancing til the sun comes up. i remember first playing human at space and shiver at floyd to now playing those records at back to back sold out nights at the kaseya center where the heat play 🤯 it has seriously been the craziest journey ever.. this weekend meant everything to me miami thank u for welcoming me with open arms i am so grateful to call this city home. (TikTok signal)

ideas.hook: Slide 1 or first frame: the city name, nothing else.
script: A few stills or short clips of the city and the room
One short line per slide or lower-third: first gig, a record you broke in, the room now
Last frame: 'this weekend meant everything'
ideas.caption: This city made the set.

ideas.title: One crazy night

Let one vocal or drop carry the whole reel
End on a still of the crowd or the sky
ideas.caption: Crazy night.
